name: Saint Ignatius of Antioch
history: Bishop of Antioch, taken under guard to Rome to be thrown to the beasts. On the way he wrote seven letters to the churches, the earliest witness outside Scripture to bishops, the Eucharist and the name 'Catholic Church'.
meditation: I am the wheat of God, and I am ground by the teeth of wild beasts, that I may be found the pure bread of Christ. What in you does God wish to grind into bread?
